An (unofficial) Zai Typescript/Javascript client

types are swagger generated from - https://developer.hellozai.com/reference/overview

# Usage

yarn

```sh
yarn add @mikeyzhang75/zai-payments
```

npm

```sh
npm install --save @mikeyzhang75/zai-payments
```

bun

```sh
bun add @mikeyzhang75/zai-payments
```

## Contributing

### Install

```sh
bun install
```

### Run tests

```sh
bun spec
```

### Type checking

```sh
bun typecheck
```

### Linting & Formatting

```sh
bun check:fix
```

## Author

👤 **MikeyZhang75 <mikeyzhang75@icloud.com>**

## Generating updated types

**Before generating types**, you must define the current Swagger version:

1. Download the desired Swagger spec version from [Zai Developer Docs](https://developer.hellozai.com/reference/overview)
2. Save it as `swagger.yaml` in the root directory
3. Run the type generation command:

```bash
npx swagger-typescript-api -p ./swagger.yaml -o ./src -n types.ts --no-client
```

**Note**: Always verify the Swagger spec version matches your target Zai API version to ensure type compatibility.

## Example

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@mikeyzhang75/zai-payments";

const baseURL = process.env.AP_SANDPIT
  ? "https://test.api.promisepay.com/"
  : "https://secure.api.promisepay.com/";

const authBaseURL = process.env.AP_SANDPIT
  ? "https://au-0000.sandbox.auth.assemblypay.com/"
  : "https://au-0000.auth.assemblypay.com/";

const dataURL = process.env.AP_SANDPIT
  ? "https://sandbox.au-0000.api.assemblypay.com/"
  : "https://au-0000.api.assemblypay.com/";

export const client = createClient({
  clientId: process.env.AP_CLIENT_ID,
  clientSecret: process.env.AP_CLIENT_SECRET,
  scope: process.env.AP_CLIENT_SCOPE,
  baseURL,
  authBaseURL,
  dataURL,
});

const itemResponse = await client.items.showItem(
  "6865E25F-3CFE-4C8C-8673-9231E0A19CF5"
);

console.log(itemResponse.items);
```

# CLAUDE.md

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

Unofficial TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for Zai (formerly Assembly Payments/PromisePay) API. This client library provides typed bindings for the Zai payments platform.

**Package**: `@mikeyzhang75/zai-payments`

## Development Commands

### Build & Type Checking
```bash
bun typecheck          # Type check without emitting files
bun build              # Clean and compile TypeScript (clean + tsc)
bun clean              # Remove lib directory
```

### Testing
```bash
bun spec               # Run Mocha test suite with ts-node
```

### Linting & Code Quality
```bash
bun check:fix          # Run Biome linter/formatter and auto-fix issues
```

### Publishing
```bash
bun prepublish         # Automatically runs build before publishing
```

## Architecture

### Client System

**Two-tier client architecture**:
- **AuthClient** (`src/client.ts:58-91`): Handles OAuth token acquisition from auth endpoint
- **Client** (`src/client.ts:94-255`): Main API client with automatic token refresh and retry logic

**Key Features**:
- **Automatic Token Refresh**: Tokens refresh 5-10 minutes before expiry (configurable jitter)
- **Retry Mechanism**: Middleware (`src/middleware.ts`) handles 401 errors with automatic token refresh and retry (default: 5 retries)
- **Error Handling**: Structured error objects with status, message, and response data
- **Logging**: Bunyan logger for debugging (DEBUG level by default)

### Authentication Flow

1. Client checks if token exists and if it's in refresh window
2. If needed, requests new token from `authBaseURL` via AuthClient
3. Stores token with calculated expiry (`expiresAt`) and refresh time (`refreshAt`)
4. Interceptor catches 401 errors, refreshes token, and retries request

### Resource Pattern

Each API resource follows a consistent factory pattern:
```typescript
// Pattern: src/resources/{resource}.ts
export default (client: Client) => ({
  operationName: (id: string, data?: RequestBody) =>
    client.request<ResponseType>({
      url: `/resource/${id}`,
      method: 'GET|POST|PATCH|DELETE',
      data,
      secure: true,  // Requires Bearer token
    })
})
```

**Resources** (`src/index.ts:44-66`):
- accounts, bankAccounts, batchTransactions, bpayAccounts
- callbacks, cardAccounts, charges, companies
- directDebitAuthorities, disbursements, fees, items
- marketplace, tokens, tokenAuths, tools
- transactions, users, walletAccounts, request

### Type Generation

Types are auto-generated from Swagger spec:
```bash
npx swagger-typescript-api -p ./swagger.yaml -o ./src -n types.ts --no-client
```

Source: https://developer.hellozai.com/reference/overview

### Environment Configuration

Three base URLs required:
- **baseURL**: Legacy API endpoint (`secure.api.promisepay.com` or `test.api.promisepay.com`)
- **authBaseURL**: OAuth endpoint (`au-0000.auth.assemblypay.com`)
- **dataURL**: New NPP data endpoint (`au-0000.api.assemblypay.com`)

Sandpit vs Production controlled by environment variables.

## Code Quality Configuration

### Biome (Linter/Formatter)
- Tab indentation, double quotes
- `noExplicitAny` disabled for: `client.ts`, `types.ts`, `request.ts`
- `noNonNullAssertion` disabled for example files

### TypeScript
- Target: ES2017, CommonJS output
- Strict mode enabled
- Declaration files generated to `lib/`
- `noImplicitAny` disabled for flexibility with API types

## Important Notes

- **Axios Version**: Using 0.21.1 (consider security review)
- **Test Framework**: Mocha + Chai + Sinon (no test files currently in repo)
- **Package Manager**: Migrated from Yarn to Bun
- **Request Security**: All API requests should use `secure: true` to include Bearer token
- **Error Handling**: Always extract ApiError details (status, statusText, data, url) from error responses
